integrity: The proof is symbolic and cutoff-free. Literature searches found no implication-equivalent classification, but an unindexed elementary note remains a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only \(\Delta_H^{-1}(k)\) for \(0\le k\le3\); higher fibers and the asymptotic distribution are not determined. Finite verification through \(10^6\) is regression evidence only.
title: Exact defect spectrum through three for the Niven–totient bound
